sql:
SELECT 
    f.School Name,
    f.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE 
    s.AvgScrRead = (SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead) FROM satscores)

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead = (SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead) FROM satscores)
AND frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)] > 0;

SELECT 
    f.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE 
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)] = (
        SELECT 
            MAX([Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)])
        FROM 
            frpm
    )

SELECT f.FRPM_Count_Ages_5_17
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    frpm.FRPM_Count_Ages_5_17
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY 
    satscores.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = REPLACE(satscores.cds, ' ', '')
WHERE satscores.rtype = 'D'
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead = (SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead) FROM satscores)

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead = (SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead) FROM satscores)

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.[School Name] = schools.School
WHERE schools.School = 'The California Charter School in the Valley'
AND schools.District = 'California Advancing Pathways for Students in Los Angeles County ROC/P'
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.[School Name] = schools.School
WHERE schools.District = 'California School for the Blind'
AND frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)] = (
    SELECT MAX(satscores.AvgScrRead)
    FROM satscores
    JOIN schools ON satscores.sname = schools.School
    WHERE schools.District = 'California School for the Blind'
);

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.`District Name` = 'California School for the Blind (State Special Schl)'
AND f.`School Name` = 'California School for the Blind'
AND s.dname = 'California School for the Blind (State Special Schl)'
AND s.sname = 'California School for the Blind'
GROUP BY f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.AvgScrRead = (SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead) FROM satscores)
AND f.Enrollment (Ages 5-17) IS NOT NULL;

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.AvgScrRead = (SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead) FROM satscores)
AND f.AgeGroup = '5-17';

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.AvgScrRead = (SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead) FROM satscores)
AND f.AgeGroup = '5-17';

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.rtype = 'D'
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;
